blocks.raw: <Tip>The Hazen-Williams equation is empirical and assumes fully turbulent flow. For fire protection systems, C = 120 is standard for new galvanized steel and will underestimate actual friction loss in older systems (use C = 100–110 for systems >10 years).</Tip>

P = (1000 × 65) / (600 × 0.80) = 65,000 / 480 = **135.4 kW** (≈181 hp)</Example>
